answer: Build a tiered sponsor tree: each new identity needs one established sponsor, a 15 POA bond locked for 12 epochs, and three independent approvals before earning. The garden registry limits each sponsor to four live children; a fifth child raises that sponsor bond by 2x and extends its lock by 6 epochs. A cipher audit verifies signed parent links, approval uniqueness, and liveness every round. If a sponsor cluster misbehaves, the hollow subtree is slashed together, so every added alias increases both collateral and coordination cost.
